purpose: Teach: しまお/登勢/橘/ウチダ/岡野/石毛/田代/安井

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「漫画家しまおさんは独特の世界観」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying Shimao the manga artist has a really unique world to his work.
lines.style: Warm, sharing-a-thought tone. Gentle opening. Steady pace, slightly lifted on the compliment. Like passing along something nice she heard.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと登勢おばあちゃんの絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I read a picture book with Dad and Grandma Tose.
lines.style: Bright, direct, gentle pride in the memory. Quick tempo. Small excitement underneath without pushing it. He's sharing something real that happened.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「橘家のお祝いに行く予定」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying he's planning to go to the Tachibana family celebration.
lines.style: Same warm vessel as before. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Relaying his words carefully, like she wants Sho to hear them right.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとウチダ家のお宅にお邪魔したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I got to visit the Uchida family's place with Dad.
lines.style: Honest, quiet contentment. Slower than before — he's lingering on the memory a little. Small voice, but solid. Not bragging, just saying what happened.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「岡野家のご親戚に会いに行こう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying he wants to go visit some of the Okano family relatives.
lines.style: Same reflective container. Slightly more weight on "wants" — she's carrying his intention forward. Measured, attentive delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと石毛さんと一緒に野球観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I watched a baseball game with Dad and Mr. Ishige.
lines.style: Steady, genuine. Medium pace. The kind of simple sentence that carries its own small weight because it mattered. Not loud, just clear.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「田代まさし時代の懐メロを聴こう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying we should listen to some nostalgic songs from back in the Tashiro Masashi era.
lines.style: Same warm, relaying tone. Slightly playful on the nostalgia — she's amused by what Dad suggested. Soft, conversational, like she's smiling a little.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと安井先輩の引退試合観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I got to watch Senpai Yasui's retirement game with Dad.
lines.style: Quieter closing line. Soft awe underneath. He's speaking of something he witnessed that meant something. Pace slows slightly. Almost reverent but still a child's voice.
